SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT E.*, C.ORGNAME AS USEDDEPARTMENTNAME, O.ORGNAME AS USEDDEPOSTNAME, U.USERNAME AS MAINTAINUSERNAME, S.USERNAME AS KEEPUSERNAME, M.EQUIPTCATEGORY AS EQUIPTCATEGORYNAME FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT E LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG C ON E.USEDDEPARTMENTID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG O ON E.USEDDEPOSTID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER U ON E.MAINTAINUSERID = U.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER S ON E.KEEPUSERID = S.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT_CATEGORY M ON E.EQUIPTCATEGORYID = M.ID) T
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORG_PERMISSION OP_ WHERE OP_.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_EMC_EQUIPT_CATEGORY' AND OP_.TARGETID = T.EQUIPTCATEGORYID AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP_ WHERE UP_.USERID = #{loginUser.id} AND UP_.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP_.TARGETID = OP_.ORGID))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${targetTable} TAR_ WHERE TAR_.${targetEquiptColumn} = T.ID
AND TAR_.${targetFilterColumn} = #{targetFilterValue}
AND TAR_.${targetFilterColumn1} = #{targetFilterValue1}
)
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT_TEST_METHOD F WHERE F.EQUIPTID = T.ID AND F.ANALYSISCATEGORY = 'sampling' AND F.TESTMETHODID = #{item} )
AND (MAINTAINUSERID IS NULL OR MAINTAINUSERID = '' OR MAINTAINUSERID LIKE '%'||#{maintenanceUserId}||'%' )
AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT_PLAN TAR_ WHERE TAR_.EQUIPTID = T.ID AND TAR_.MAINTENDDATE <= SYSDATE + TAR_.WARNINGDAYS )
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT E.*, C.ORGNAME AS USEDDEPARTMENTNAME, O.ORGNAME AS USEDDEPOSTNAME, U.USERNAME AS MAINTAINUSERNAME, S.USERNAME AS KEEPUSERNAME FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT E LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG C ON E.USEDDEPARTMENTID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG O ON E.USEDDEPOSTID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER U ON E.MAINTAINUSERID = U.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER S ON E.KEEPUSERID = S.ID WHERE E.ID = #{id}

SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT B.*,A.CYCLE,A.WARNINGDAYS,A.MAINTENDDATE,A.GIST,A.VERIFYORG,C.CODENAME FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT B LEFT JOIN (SELECT P.*,M.MAINTEVENT FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT_PLAN P,T_EMC_EQUIPT_MAINT M WHERE P.MAINTID = M.ID AND M.MAINTEVENT = 'equiptVerification' ) A ON B.ID = A.EQUIPTID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_CODE C ON A.MAINTEVENT = C.CODE AND C.CODECATEGORYID = 'maintainEvent' WHERE A.MAINTEVENT = 'equiptVerification' ) T

SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT B.*,A.CYCLE,A.WARNINGDAYS,A.MAINTENDDATE,A.GIST,A.VERIFYORG,C.CODENAME FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT B LEFT JOIN (SELECT P.*,M.MAINTEVENT FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT_PLAN P,T_EMC_EQUIPT_MAINT M WHERE P.MAINTID = M.ID AND M.MAINTEVENT = 'equiptCalibration') A ON B.ID = A.EQUIPTID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_CODE C ON A.MAINTEVENT = C.CODE AND C.CODECATEGORYID = 'maintainEvent' WHERE A.MAINTEVENT = 'equiptCalibration' ) T

SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT B.*,A.CYCLE,A.WARNINGDAYS,A.MAINTENDDATE,A.CHECKREASON,C.CODENAME FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT B LEFT JOIN (SELECT P.*,M.MAINTEVENT FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT_PER_CHECK_PLAN P,T_EMC_EQUIPT_MAINT M WHERE P.MAINTID = M.ID AND M.MAINTEVENT = 'duringCheck') A ON B.ID = A.EQUIPTID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_CODE C ON A.MAINTEVENT = C.CODE AND C.CODECATEGORYID = 'maintainEvent' WHERE A.MAINTEVENT = 'duringCheck' ) T
SELECT E.* FROM ( SELECT T.EQUIPTCATEGORYID, MAX( T.EQUIPTID ) AS EQUIPTID FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT T WHERE T.EQUIPTCATEGORYID = #{equiptCategoryId} ) E

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.ID, E.ORGID, A.CREATEDBYORGID, E.EQUIPTID AS EQUIPTNO, E.EQUIPTNAME, E.SPECIFICATION, A.VERIFYORG, A.CYCLE, A.REMARK, E.KEEPUSERID, U.USERNAME AS KEEPUSERNAME FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT_PLAN A INNER JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT E ON A.EQUIPTID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER U ON E.KEEPUSERID = U.ID) T

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.ID, E.ORGID, A.CREATEDBYORGID, E.EQUIPTID AS EQUIPTNO, E.EQUIPTNAME, E.SPECIFICATION, A.MAINTDATE, A.CHECKWAY, A.CHECKREASON, A.CHECKUSERID, A.CHECKUSERNAME, A.REMARK FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT_PER_CHECK_PLAN A INNER JOIN T_EMC_EQUIPT E ON A.EQUIPTID = E.ID) T
SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT E.ID, E.ORGID, E.CREATEDBYORGID, E.EQUIPTID AS EQUIPTNO, E.EQUIPTNAME, E.SPECIFICATION, E.USEDUSERNAME AS USERS FROM T_EMC_EQUIPT E) T
